messages.subject: save output from HTML()
parts:
Hi All:

I embedded some html code inside the shinyUI using the HTML() function. It will return an output named 'ILData'. I can use the document.write() function to display the output to the page, but I failed to save the output. (I have to save the output and use it again in the sever.R). I tried to save input$ILData or ILData, but none of them works. 

Here is my code：

ui.R
=====================
shinyUI(mainPanel(
  HTML('<body>
          <script type="text/javascript" src="http://counter.sina.com.cn/ip/" charset="gb2312"></script>       <!--get IP address -->  
          <script type="text/javascript">   
          document.writeln("IP："+ILData[0]+"<br />");             //output IP address  
          </script>  
          </body>'),
  textOutput('IP'))
        )

server.R
==============================
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$IP <- renderPrint(input$ILData)
})

You can see the from my app http://glimmer.rstudio.com/jianhua/ip/ that the document.write() function can display the IP address correctly. However, when I tried to call it in server.R and render the output to ui.R again, it return NULL. Any suggestion how to save the output/variable from HTML? I have tried to find the solution for a whole day, but no luck.

Thanks for any suggestion or clue.

Jianhua
